hypothesis: The missing literal You call means stopping an occupation loses its message.
supportedReachableSetup: An active non-eating occupation such as counted waiting interrupted through stop_occupation, using the production callback contract.
expectedC: If an active occupation does not finish a meal, emit You stop <occtxt>., clear occupation, mark status dirty, nomul(0), and clear canned commands.
observedJS: The env.message callback receives the complete interpolated text, followed by the same state changes. No occupation emits no stop message. Focused test checks waiting and searching plus no-occupation control.
control: No-occupation state at multi=-1 emits nothing, keeps multi negative and clears CQ_CANNED.
scope: Message formatting and stop-state updates for active non-eating occupations with a valid callback. Does not certify every caller passes the callback, completed-meal behavior, or every possible occupation.
generalization: Direct call-name mismatch is insufficient when output is carried by a required callback. Suppression requires tracing callback resolution and argument/state semantics; this is not a blanket helper-presence rule.
